metadata.explanation: Compositional task: insert audio (0.5 credit) AND change slide 1 transition from 'honeycomb' to 'fade' (0.5 credit). Getter reads PPTX ZIP to check slide 1 audio rels and transition child element name. Initial state has honeycomb transition and no audio. [Fixed: renamed functions from invalid 8-char suffix 'e9cd8cb3' to correct 32-char MD5 hash '1b19ca869f4a35a02b8d110c7e17b7e9']
fix_history: Fix 1: Renamed getter 'get_impress_audio_and_transition__e9cd8cb3' to 'get_impress_audio_and_transition__1b19ca869f4a35a02b8d110c7e17b7e9' (invalid 8-char MD5 suffix -> correct 32-char MD5 hash)
Fix 2: Renamed metric 'check_impress_audio_and_transition__e9cd8cb3' to 'check_impress_audio_and_transition__1b19ca869f4a35a02b8d110c7e17b7e9' (invalid 8-char MD5 suffix -> correct 32-char MD5 hash)
Fix 3: Updated evaluator.func and evaluator.result.type in task JSON to use correct 32-char MD5 hash

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads the saved PPTX as a ZIP archive and checks both sub-goals: audio presence and transition type.
Audio detection checks slide relationships file for relationship Type containing 'audio', which matches the standard OOXML audio relationship URL.
Transition detection extracts the local tag name of the first child of <p:transition>; for a Fade transition LibreOffice saves <p:fade/>, yielding 'fade' which matches the expected value.
Metric awards 0.5 credit per sub-goal (audio + fade transition), fully covering both task requirements.
Negative control resistant: initial state has no audio and a honeycomb transition, so the initial score is 0.0.
Postconfig saves the file before evaluation, ensuring the getter reads the final state.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: if LibreOffice emits a non-standard audio relationship type, the 'audio' substring check may miss it. Consider also checking for media relationship types as a fallback.
Minor: if <p:transition> has no children but a 'type' attribute is used (rare cases), the code returns 'cut' even if a real transition type is set — low risk for the Fade case.
